why: Insert an interval and test overlap: each booking [s, e) is accepted only if it overlaps no accepted booking, and half-open intervals overlap exactly when s < otherEnd and otherStart < e. Keep accepted bookings sorted so only the neighbours need checking.
hints: Write the overlap test for two half-open intervals [s1, e1) and [s2, e2). What changes because the end is exclusive?
They overlap iff s1 < e2 and s2 < e1. If you keep accepted bookings sorted by start, the new one can only collide with the booking just before it or just after it.

Keep a sorted list of starts (and ends); bisect for the insertion point, check the previous booking's end <= s and the next booking's start >= e, then insert. O(n log n) with a balanced structure, O(n^2) worst with a list insert, which is fine here.
pitfalls: Touching bookings ([10,20) then [20,30)) are both accepted.
A rejected booking must not be stored.
